name: procurement-intelligence
description: Procurement Intelligence monorepo: Express/TypeScript API, React/Vite web app, MongoDB.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @pi/api" "npm run dev -w @pi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi/api && npm run build -w @pi/web
scripts.docker:down: docker compose --profile app --profile tools --profile seed down
